name: Gull-wing lip lift

lead: The gull-wing lip lift is a direct lip lift: skin is excised at or just above the white roll (lip border), shaped like gull wings, to move the vermilion outward and make the upper lip show more.
People seek it for a more defined cupid's bow and fuller-looking lip. Surgeons report high patient satisfaction, though no single technique has become the standard.

paras: A surgeon performs it in about 20 minutes. Recovery involves swelling for 1-2 weeks and tightness for 2-4 months, and rest is advised for at least a week.

Possible complications include numbness, stiffness, asymmetry, under-correction, smile deformation and visible or hypertrophic scarring; removing skin at the white roll is specifically linked to poor scarring and stiffness.

chain: Skin excised at the lip border
angle.text: Excision along the border of the upper lip raises the cupid's bow and increases visible vermilion, giving a more defined lip.

lead: The gull-wing lip lift is a direct lip lift in which skin is removed from or just above the white roll at the lip border, with incisions shaped like gull wings.[1] It moves the vermilion outward toward the mouth corners and, on the lower lip, increases projection, and takes about 20 minutes.[1]

It differs from the subnasal (bullhorn) lift, where an ellipse is removed under the nose, and from non-surgical lip augmentation.[1] Surgeons report high patient satisfaction but no single technique has become standard; demand has declined as fillers improved.[1]

paras: Direct lifts excise skin at the vermilion border, whereas subnasal bullhorn lifts place the scar under the nose; corner lifts and V-Y augmentations are other variants.[1]

Numbness, stiffness, pain, paresthesia, lip distortion, smile deformation, speech problems, asymmetry, under-correction and scarring are described, with white-roll skin removal linked to poor scarring and stiffness.[1] Swelling subsides within 1-2 weeks; tightness may last 2-4 months.[1]
No studies found. A general overview notes surgeons report high satisfaction across lip lift techniques without a standard.[1]
